class.name: MidiStream
class.brief_description: An AudioStream that plays MIDI files using SoundFont synthesis.
class.description: [MidiStream] plays a MIDI file through the TinySoundFont SoundFont 2 synthesizer. Assign it to an [AudioStreamPlayer], [AudioStreamPlayer2D], or [AudioStreamPlayer3D] to get playback with the standard bus/volume controls, including 3D spatialization. Set [member soundfont] to an imported SoundFont 2 resource (`.sf2`) and [member midi] to an imported MIDI file resource (`.mid`/`.midi`). [member loop] restarts the song when it ends; [member midi_speed] scales the playback tempo. The General MIDI instrument, note, and drum note constants are provided as enums ([enum GeneralMidiInstrument], [enum MidiNote], [enum MidiDrumNote]) for use with live note triggering via [method AudioStreamPlayback.get_playback] and [method MidiStreamPlayback.note_on].

method.name: set_soundfont
method.description: Sets the SoundFont used for synthesis.

method.name: get_soundfont
method.description: Returns the SoundFont used for synthesis.

method.name: set_midi
method.description: Sets the MIDI file to play.

method.name: get_midi
method.description: Returns the MIDI file being played.

method.name: set_loop
method.description: If [code]true[/code], the song restarts from the beginning when it ends.

method.name: set_midi_speed
method.description: Sets the playback tempo scale (1.0 is the file's original tempo).
